claim: Milestone 2A bounded pilot: one seed, two epochs, small train and validation subsets, no test-partition access. Pilot results are non-scientific development checks (1 seed, 2 epochs, small subsets, validation data only) and carry no accuracy or robustness conclusion.

subsets.seed_rule: derived_seed('pilot-subset', split_seed, <subset name>) with split_seed read from split_m2.json

e4_plumbing.subset: stratified subset of the 270-row attack subset
e4_plumbing.reason: bounds pilot run time (pgd50x5 costs about 4x pgd20 per row on this CPU); the pilot E4 run checks the code path and measures cost only and decides nothing about budget adequacy

banner: Pilot results are non-scientific development checks (1 seed, 2 epochs, small subsets, validation data only) and carry no accuracy or robustness conclusion.
